This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 5" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their enlarged craniums featuring a variety of deep grooves on the sides and back.<ref name="Chapter 5" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY Date">{{BoBFDate}}</ref> a member of this species was associated with an [[Ishi Tib]] [[Unidentified Ishi Tib guild master|guild master]], present alongside their cohorts on the [[Glavis Ringworld]] [[space station]] when the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] arrived with the [[Dismemberment|severed]] head of the [[Klatooinian]] [[Kaba Baiz]].<ref name="Chapter 5" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Chapter 5: Return of the Mandalorian|fifth episode]] of the [[2021]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', directed by [[Bryce Dallas Howard]].<ref name="Chapter 5" />
